states.meaning: Every required assertion passed for the exact candidate and all effects are verified.
An artifact exists but one or more required assertions failed.
A same-level conflict or external condition prevents safe progress.
The next proposed effect exceeds the active authority envelope.
A declared iteration, retry, time, tool, model-cost, or external-cost budget ended.
An operator or orchestrator stopped the run.

invariants: No unrecognized terminal state is success.
A missing required evidence item makes the claimed terminal state invalid.
Knowledge recall cannot change any terminal state.
A succeeded outcome contains no failed or blocked assertion and no unverified effect.
